boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Stevenson University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and snack stops in and around Owings Mills with directly published late-hours evidence.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Reistertown Road
cards.subtitle: 10245 Reistertown Road, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a later food option; confirm the service mode before leaving, since the dining room closes earlier than the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A nearby drive-thru option with published hours through 4:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this Owings Mills location's drive-thru as open 9:00 AM–4:00 AM daily and its dine-in service until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours are 9:00 AM–4:00 AM daily; dine-in hours are listed until 12:00 AM. Recheck before travel.

cards.title: Wendy’s at Lakeside Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 9243 Lakeside Boulevard, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Treat this as a practical all-night food stop and use the posted restaurant or drive-thru hours to choose the service option that fits your visit.
cards.short_summary: An Owings Mills Wendy’s with nearly round-the-clock published restaurant and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 4:00 AM–3:59 AM every day for its 9243 Lakeside Boulevard location.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are published as 4:00 AM–3:59 AM daily. Recheck hours before travel.

cards.title: Bellagio Wings & Pizza
cards.subtitle: 10999 Red Run Boulevard, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday pickup or delivery order if midnight food is useful; the restaurant’s own site lists those as its latest closing nights.
cards.short_summary: A locally named pizza-and-wings stop with Friday and Saturday hours to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Bellagio Wings & Pizza lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 AM–12:00 AM at 10999 Red Run Boulevard in Owings Mills.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant publishes Friday and Saturday hours until 12:00 AM; other nights close earlier. Recheck before travel.

cards.entity_name: The Market at Hyatt Place Baltimore/Owings Mills
cards.title: The Market at Hyatt Place
cards.subtitle: 4730 Painters Mill Road, Owings Mills
cards.notes: For packaged snacks or a quick grab-and-go item, check with the hotel before going; its dining page identifies The Market as open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A hotel grab-and-go market listed as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hyatt Place Baltimore/Owings Mills states that The Market offers packaged grab-and-go items and is open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The hotel publishes The Market as open 24 hours. Ask staff about current guest-access and item availability.

cards.title: Domino’s in Reisterstown
cards.subtitle: 11616 Reisterstown Road, Reisterstown
cards.notes: Use online ordering or call ahead for a late carryout or delivery plan; the location page gives the address and an overnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Reisterstown pizza stop whose official page lists closing at 1:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's identifies its Reisterstown store at 11616 Reisterstown Road and lists it as open until 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the store open until 1:00 AM. Check the ordering page for the current carryout or delivery cutoff.

cards.title: Papa Johns on Reisterstown Road
cards.subtitle: 11708-A Reisterstown Road, Reisterstown
cards.notes: Keep this for Friday or Saturday delivery or carryout planning; the official location page distinguishes later delivery hours from carryout closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Reisterstown pizza option with delivery to 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday, and carryout until 12:30 AM, at 11708-A Reisterstown Road.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday delivery is listed until 1:00 AM; carryout until 12:30 AM. Other nights close earlier. Recheck before ordering.

cards.title: Domino’s in Randallstown
cards.subtitle: 3502 Brenbrook Drive, Randallstown
cards.notes: Order ahead if delivery or carryout works better for your route; the official store page provides its address and late closing time for a conservative backup plan.
cards.short_summary: A Randallstown Domino’s location listed as open until 1:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its 3502 Brenbrook Drive location in Randallstown as open until 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the store open until 1:00 AM. Confirm current delivery area and order cutoff before leaving campus.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Liberty Road
cards.subtitle: 8610 Liberty Road, Randallstown
cards.notes: Use the listed restaurant or drive-thru service as a late backup when heading toward Randallstown; verify the location’s current service availability before departing.
cards.short_summary: A Randallstown Wendy’s with published hours from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 4:00 AM–3:59 AM daily for its 8610 Liberty Road location in Randallstown.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are published as 4:00 AM–3:59 AM daily. Recheck hours before travel.

cards.title: Domino’s in Pikesville
cards.subtitle: 607 Reisterstown Road, Pikesville
cards.notes: Use this as a route-based delivery or carryout alternative when you are already headed south; check the store page for the day’s operating and ordering details.
cards.short_summary: A Pikesville Domino’s location listed as open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's identifies its Pikesville location at 607 Reisterstown Road and lists it as open until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the store open until 12:00 AM. Confirm delivery coverage and current ordering cutoff first.

cards.title: The Greene Turtle in Owings Mills
cards.subtitle: 2 Restaurant Park Drive, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Choose a food-focused visit and confirm seating or takeout details in advance; this is a restaurant open to all ages, though it also has a bar program.
cards.short_summary: An Owings Mills restaurant with food-service hours through 1:00 AM or 2:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greene Turtle lists its Owings Mills location open until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and until 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 11:00 AM–1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 AM–2:00 AM Friday–Saturday. Confirm kitchen and under-21 seating details before travel.
